_how: Land size comes from the council's IntraMaps 'Legal Area' (Jason 25 Nov 2026). Open the url in the Browser pane, accept the disclaimer, Address Search tab -> House Number + Street (pick from the list) -> Search -> read 'Legal Area' (and PIPARCEL / Lot / Description) in the PROPERTY BOUNDARY panel. Put it in the day file as "area": <number>, "areaSource": "IntraMaps <council> Legal Area". Side lengths still come only from the land plan. When you use a council not marked verified, find its IntraMaps link from 'maps' below, test it, and update this file (url, verified).
